description: In-app payment collection — cards, wallets, invoices, and payouts.

screens_added.name: Payout Settings
screens_added.purpose: For seller/provider — bank account + payout schedule

flows_added: Add card → verify → save → use at checkout
Checkout → select payment method → confirm → biometric → success
Request refund → select reason → submit → status tracking
Provider payout → view earnings → request payout → bank transfer
interaction_patterns: Biometric confirmation on every payment action
Card number input — auto-formats with spaces every 4 digits
Large numeric keypad for amount entry — never standard keyboard
Security confirmation step always before money movement
Success screen — confetti or pulse animation on payment complete
Debit shown in red, credit in green — always

error_flows.ui: Inline error below payment method: 'Card declined — please check your details or try a different card'. Red border on card fields. Specific decline reason if available (insufficient funds vs card blocked). Order NOT created. Cart fully preserved. Retry without re-entering entire form.

Return from bank verification to checkout with message: 'Verification failed — your bank did not approve this payment'. Try different card CTA. Explain that no charge was made. Never leave user on a blank redirect.

After 30 seconds: spinner replaced with: 'This is taking longer than expected'. After 60 seconds: 'Payment timed out — please try again'. Show whether charge was made. If unknown: 'Check your bank before retrying to avoid double charge'.

In earnings screen: amber badge 'Payout failed'. Reason shown: invalid bank details, account verification needed. CTA: 'Update bank details'. Retry scheduled automatically once fixed. Funds held safely — never lost.
Toast: 'Refund could not be processed at this time'. Estimated retry time shown. Support contact CTA. Never tell user refund was successful before it is confirmed.

Push notification: 'Payment failed for your subscription'. Grace period shown: 'Your access continues for X days'. CTA: 'Update payment method'. After grace period: downgrade to free, not full lockout.

edge_cases.case: User attempts to pay with expired card
edge_cases.ui: Expired badge on saved card. Expired card cannot be selected as payment method. Prompt to add new card. Never allow selection and fail at confirmation.

edge_cases.case: Partial refund on a multi-item order
edge_cases.ui: Show itemised refund breakdown. Clearly show which items are refunded and which are not. Total refund amount prominently displayed. Timeline shown.
Before confirming: show exact amount in user's local currency with exchange rate. Timestamp rate. 'Charged in [currency] — converted at [rate] on [date]' always visible on receipt.
Payment button disabled immediately on first tap. Subsequent taps ignored silently. Idempotency key used on backend. If duplicate charge occurs: auto-refund and notify.

edge_cases.case: Free trial ends while user is mid-session
edge_cases.ui: Non-intrusive banner: 'Your free trial has ended'. Do not interrupt current action. On next significant action: paywall shown with upgrade CTA. Never mid-flow modal that blocks current task.

edge_cases.case: Promo code applied but discount not reflected
edge_cases.ui: Show code as applied with green tick. If discount not calculating: 'Code applied but no eligible items in cart'. Specific reason if possible. Never silently fail.

classification_note: Primary when selected. Strong signal in description — 'pay', 'checkout', 'purchase', 'subscription'.
